title: calliandra haematomma var. locoensis
intro: Calliandra haematomma var. locoensis, commonly known as Red Powder Puff, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Powder Puff include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Red Powder Puff are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
